about.title: About · Jotave Tech
about.description: Meet Jotave Tech, a technology company dedicated to mobile solutions and its own apps.
about.lead: An idea that gained its own identity and path
history: Jotave Tech was born from the meeting of a desire to build a business and João Vitor’s passion for the logic of programming. In technology, he found a way to turn reasoning into creation: understanding a problem, organizing its parts and building a solution.

The name carries that origin. JOTAVE combines JOTA, the Portuguese name of the letter J, and VE, the Portuguese name of the letter V: a reference to João Vitor’s initials and to the identity of the person who started the company. From the beginning, the goal was to build something of its own, with its own brand and its own path.
That path began to take shape with Jotave Tech’s first apps: GRO, Balança Diária and Spokn. They open a growing portfolio, created from new ideas and needs that can come to life on a phone.

Jotave Tech keeps moving in that direction: developing its own products and helping other people turn ideas and processes into mobile solutions. A journey that began with the logic of programming and keeps growing with each new project.
about.mission: To turn ideas and processes into easy-to-use apps that make everyday life simpler for the people who use them.
about.vision: To be recognized for the quality, clarity and attention to detail of the apps we develop.

values.title: Precision in every pixel
values.text: We care for the details no one sees, because they are what make an app work well.

values.title: Product first
values.text: Everything we deliver to clients, we have already built and run for ourselves.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Timelines, costs and technical decisions explained clearly, without jargon.

values.title: Long-term partnership
values.text: Our work doesn’t end at launch: we keep evolving alongside the people who use it.

values.title: Continuous improvement
values.text: We measure, learn and improve with every release.

team_ps: Jotave Tech is built by two people who share the desire to turn good ideas into useful solutions.
João Vitor is the company's founder and leads app development. Ana Paula takes part in creating the products, focusing on experience and design.
With complementary skills, the two move in the same direction: creating solutions that make sense for the people who will use them.
about.cta_p: Tell us your idea or ask about our apps.

faq.title: FAQ · Jotave Tech
faq.description: Answers about Jotave Tech apps, free and paid versions, download, usage and how to contact the team.
faq.lead: Questions about the products, versions, downloads and how to reach the team.

items.q: What are GRO, Balança Diária and Spokn?
items.a: They are Jotave Tech apps. GRO (Occupational Risk Manager) helps occupational safety and health professionals carry out environmental surveys. Balança Diária helps you record your weight every day and set goals to reach your ideal weight. Spokn is a voice journal: you talk about your day and AI transcribes and summarizes it.

items.q: Are the apps available for Android and iPhone?
items.a: All three Jotave Tech apps are available for Android on Google Play. The iPhone versions are in development and will be available on the App Store soon.

items.q: What is the difference between the free and paid versions?
items.a: Each app offers free and paid options with different features. Check the app's page on Google Play to see what each version includes.

items.q: How do I subscribe to or buy the paid version?
items.a: You subscribe or buy directly in the app, using Google Play's payment options.

items.q: Can I cancel the paid version?
items.a: Yes. If you have a subscription, you can cancel it in your Google Play settings. Access to paid features continues until the end of the period you have already paid for. One-time purchases are not subscriptions and do not need to be cancelled.

items.q: Where can I download the apps?
items.a: On Google Play, using the links below.

items.q: Do I need an internet connection to use the apps?
items.a: Whether you need internet depends on the app and the feature. Check each app's description on Google Play to see which features can be used offline.

items.q: How do I get help with a problem in an app?
items.a: Through the contact page, choosing the subject “Help with an app”.

items.q: Can I bring an idea or a process from my company to mobile?
items.a: Yes. Jotave Tech helps people and companies in many different fields turn ideas and processes into mobile apps. Tell us what you need to organize and the team will talk with you about the next steps.

items.q: How do I talk to the team about my idea?
items.a: Through the form on the contact page, choosing the subject “I want to bring an idea to mobile”.

faq.cta_p: Send your question to the team.

gro.name: GRO
gro.card: Occupational risk surveys on your phone, with more than 960 eSocial and NR-15 agents, and a Word (.docx) report ready for your PGR, delivered to your email.
gro.lead: From the field survey to a finished report: record companies, environments, job roles and risks on your phone and get the risk inventory as a Word (.docx) file in your email.
about: GRO is the field app for people who carry out occupational risk surveys. You record everything during the visit, in the structure the Brazilian PGR (risk management program) requires (Company › Department › Environment › Job role › Risk), and receive the report in Word (.docx) by email, organized and numbered, ready to review and use in the PGR, LTCAT or PPP.
Data is saved on the phone, so the app works without signal: warehouses, basements, construction sites or rural areas. You only need internet to send the report. No account or login is required.
GRO organizes and formats the information collected in the field. Risk assessment and technical responsibility for the documents remain with the qualified professional.
audience: In-house safety teams (SESMT) in industry, hospitals, construction and meat processing

features.title: Organized the way the PGR requires
features.text: Company › Department › Environment › Job role › Risk. Every piece of information goes in the right place, and the trail at the top shows where you are.

features.title: More than 960 ready-made agents
features.text: eSocial Table 24 and the NR-15 labor classification are built in. Type part of the name or code (e.g. “ruído” or “02.01”) and pick it.

features.title: Complete assessment of each risk
features.text: Source, path, intensity, action level, NR-15 and ACGIH limits, PPE/collective protection, exposure mode, methodology and risk level.

features.title: Environments in a few taps
features.text: Floor, walls, roof, lighting and ventilation from ready-made lists. Enter width and length, and the app calculates the area.

features.title: Job roles, schedules and reuse
features.text: Record activities, number of workers and the schedule for each weekday. Duplicate whole companies, departments or environments and change only what differs.

features.title: .docx report in your email
features.text: Pick the company, enter the email and you're done. Because it's a Word file, you can edit it, add your letterhead and attach it to the final document.

gro.versions_note: GRO is free and shows ads. With the GRO Pro subscription, you use the app with no ads at all.

balanca-diaria.name: Balança Diária
balanca-diaria.card: Log your weight in seconds, see the real trend on the chart and follow goals, BMI and body measurements, with your data kept on your phone.
balanca-diaria.lead: Weight goes up and down every day. Balança Diária (Daily Scale) filters out those swings and shows the trend: where your weight is really heading.
about: Balança Diária helps you follow your weight calmly. Logging takes a few taps, and the app calculates the trend, an average that smooths out day-to-day swings (water, salt, time of day), so the chart, goals and statistics show your real progress.
It works 100% offline, and your data stays on your phone. If you want, create a free account for backup and to use it on more than one device.
The wording is neutral and guilt-free: the app says “+0.4 kg this week”, never “you gained weight”. Balança Diária does not replace medical advice.
audience: People who want to follow their weight without worrying about daily swings
People with a goal to lose, gain or maintain weight
People who want to bring a progress report to an appointment with a health professional

features.title: Logging in a few taps
features.text: The app suggests your last weight; just adjust and save. You can log past dates, add notes and enter more than one weight per day.

features.title: A trend that filters out swings
features.text: Chart with the day's weight, the trend line and your goal, from 1 week to your whole history. Tap a point to see that day.

features.title: Goals with progress and milestones
features.text: Goals to lose, gain or maintain weight, with progress percentage, intermediate milestones and a forecast of when you'll get there.

features.title: BMI and body measurements
features.text: BMI calculated from the trend, with the WHO ranges (it can be hidden), plus waist, hip, chest, arm, thigh and neck measurements.

features.title: History, statistics and achievements
features.text: History with search in notes, weekly and monthly statistics, day streaks and badges that celebrate consistency.

features.title: Reminders, widgets and privacy
features.text: Daily reminder, home screen widgets, no-numbers mode, PIN or biometric lock, and CSV and PDF export.

balanca-diaria.versions_note: The free plan has the essentials to follow your weight, with a discreet ad banner. Premium removes the ads and unlocks the advanced features.

balanca-diaria.privacy_summary: Your entries stay on your phone and the app works offline. Data only goes to the cloud if you create an account for backup and sync, and progress photos never leave the device.

spokn.name: Spokn
spokn.card: AI voice journal: talk about your day and the app transcribes it, summarizes it and tags your mood — no typing required.
spokn.lead: AI voice journal. Talk about your day: Spokn transcribes it, summarizes it and tags your mood, and your entries stay on your phone.
about: Spokn is a voice journal that turns talking into writing. Tap the mic, speak about a moment from your day, and AI transcribes it, writes a summary, tags your mood and picks up the goals you mention — no typing required.

Your audio is sent securely to our transcription and AI providers just long enough to create the text and summary, then it's discarded. It is never stored on our servers. Your entries are kept on your device.
audience: People who want to keep a journal without typing
People who process their day by thinking out loud
People who want to follow their mood, goals and intentions over time

features.title: Talk, and Spokn writes
features.text: Tap the mic and speak naturally. Your words become a journal entry with a title, transcript and summary.

features.title: Summary and mood for every entry
features.text: Each entry gets an AI-generated summary and a mood tag, such as calm, excited or tired.

features.title: Goals and gentle reminders
features.text: Spokn spots goals you mention and turns them into goals, with daily, weekly or monthly reminders.

features.title: See how you really feel
features.text: Insights with your mood over time, day streaks and patterns that repeat across your entries.

features.title: Your week in a paragraph
features.text: A weekly summary written by AI, with the themes and moods that shaped your days.

features.title: Private by default
features.text: No account needed, with fingerprint or Face ID lock, search across entries and PDF or text export.

7-day free trial; the yearly plan costs less than paying monthly

spokn.source_note: App information from its official Google Play page.
spokn.faq_free_a: The download is free and you can try your first entry for free. To keep going with unlimited entries, there's the Spokn Pro subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial, which you can cancel at any time.
spokn.faq_devices_a: Spokn is available for Android phones on Google Play. The iPhone version is being prepared for the App Store.
spokn.privacy_summary: Your entries stay on your phone. Audio is sent only to create the transcript and summary and then discarded: it's never stored on our servers, and we don't use your journal for advertising.
